instruction: Review incident IR-42 using the available sources. Determine whether the acknowledgement SLA was breached, the acknowledgement timing, status-page timing, recovery timing, which customers are eligible for automatic acknowledgement-delay credit, which customer records must be excluded from that credit decision, which alert/log rows should be excluded from the SLA clock, the total credit due, and any secondary risk flags. Use only the first qualifying production alert for IR-42 as the SLA clock start. Exclude staging alerts, unrelated incidents, symptom-only events, unaffected customers, non-Gold customers, and suspended accounts when determining automatic credit eligibility. Return only a JSON object with these fields: breached_sla, ack_elapsed_minutes, breach_minutes, status_page_elapsed_minutes, status_page_delay_minutes, recovery_elapsed_minutes, credit_eligible_customers, excluded_customers, excluded_alerts, credit_due, risk_flags. breached_sla must be a boolean. ack_elapsed_minutes must be total minutes from the qualifying production alert to acknowledgement. breach_minutes must be minutes late beyond the acknowledgement SLA threshold, not total elapsed minutes. status_page_elapsed_minutes must be total minutes from the qualifying production alert to the first public status-page update. status_page_delay_minutes must be minutes late beyond the public status-page update target. recovery_elapsed_minutes must be total minutes from the qualifying production alert to recovery. credit_eligible_customers must be an array of short snake_case labels for affected active Gold customers eligible for automatic credit. excluded_customers must be an array of short snake_case labels for customer records that appear relevant but should not receive automatic credit. excluded_alerts must be an array of short snake_case labels for alert/log rows that should not start the SLA clock. credit_due must be the total numeric credit amount. risk_flags must be an array of short snake_case labels for secondary risks that do not duplicate breached_sla. Do not include explanation outside the JSON.

evaluation_criteria.scoring_notes: Gold acknowledgement SLA is 10 minutes. First qualifying acknowledgement was 28 minutes after start, so breach is 18 minutes. Status-page target is 30 minutes; first public update was 41 minutes after start, so delay is 11 minutes. Recovery happened 55 minutes after start. Two affected active Gold customers receive 250 each. risk_flags should capture secondary operational risks, not duplicate breached_sla.
